description: Use this when the couple asks how their own wedding planning goes. The signed-in couple's own wedding on Zola, as an overview: names, date, days to go, place, website, paper drafts, checklist, and up to 3 next steps. With account:read, it also gives the guest list and RSVP progress, the registry and completion discount, the booked vendor types, and the budget total. An older connection gives each of these parts only with its own access, and the part is absent without it. Gives counts only, no guest names. Requires Zola sign-in (account:read). Do not use for the usual milestones of a wedding date: use zola_get_planning_timeline_template.
name: zola_get_my_planning_overview

outputSchema.description: The wedding of the signed-in user

booked_vendor_types.description: The vendor types that the couple booked. Only with read access to the vendors

budget.description: Only with read access to the budget

completion_discount_available.description: Only with read access to the registry

exists.description: False when the signed-in user has no wedding on Zola

guests.description: Only with read access to the guest list

rsvp_events.description: The events that collect RSVPs, main events first

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

next_steps.description: At most 3 next steps. Empty after the wedding. A next step about guests, registry, or budget needs the access to that data

paper_drafts.description: Paper drafts by card type, only the card types with drafts

registry.description: Only with read access to the registry

role.description: The role of the user on the wedding: owner or partner

unknown.description: The sections that Zola could not read. They are not zero

url.description: The public wedding website, when it is published

wedding.description: Null when Zola could not read it

days_until_wedding.description: Days from today (UTC) to the wedding. Negative after the wedding

title: Get My Wedding Overview
